attributes.action: To close down mossbourne (all in Hackney) or change the policies
attributes.additional_details: Mossbourne is just like a prison it traps kids without any freedom hair has to be in one unit skirt below the knees one way system no colour in hair we aren’t allowed to wear our own jacket or have labels on of clothes has to be full mossbourne attire no phones allowed we have out of playground where kids aren’t allowed outside for the whole day
attributes.background: To close down mossbourne and investigate the emotional trauma it gives to kids or force them to change their policies to make it more manageable to kids

rejection.details: The policies of individual schools are not a matter for central Government or for Parliament.
